description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations -  Industrial Disputes between Mr. A. A. Karunaratne Vs. Kahatagaha Graphite Lanka Limited and two other notices
categorisation: This gazette contains orders under the Industrial Disputes Act, appointing arbitrators to settle specific industrial disputes between employees and employers. It references specific legal provisions (Section 4(1) of Chapter 131) and involves the exercise of statutory powers by the Minister. This falls under legal/regulatory matters as it deals with the implementation and application of existing labor laws and regulations to resolve specific disputes through established legal procedures.
